zh: 并行 eligibility 由 dependency、effect/resource conflict 与 capacity 独立约束
structured concurrency 将 child lifecycle、deadline、cancellation 与 failure policy 绑定到 parent scope
bounded queue、semaphore 与 demand-based dispatch 形成 backpressure
并发结果按稳定规则 join，并用 projection version 保留决策所见事实
en: Parallel eligibility is independently constrained by dependencies, effect or resource conflicts, and capacity
Structured concurrency binds child lifetimes, deadlines, cancellation, and failure policy to a parent scope
Bounded queues, semaphores, and demand-based dispatch create backpressure
Concurrent results join in stable order and projection versions preserve the facts visible to each decision

next.en: Move into idempotency and durable recovery: idempotency keys, deduplication ledgers, retry and backoff, checkpoints and replay, compensation, and the exactly-once illusion.
